prediction.sql: WITH female_client AS (SELECT client_id, district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date = '1976-01-29'), client_accounts AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.date AS account_open_date FROM account AS a JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN female_client AS fc ON fc.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'), account_transactions AS (SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance FROM trans AS t WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id), loan_counts AS (SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loan AS l GROUP BY l.account_id), card_counts AS (SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count FROM card AS c JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id GROUP BY d.account_id) SELECT (SELECT A2 FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM female_client)) AS residence_district, dist.A2 AS account_district, CASE WHEN dist.A2 = (SELECT A2 FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM female_client)) THEN 'Same as residence' ELSE 'Different from residence' END AS district_comparison, ca.account_open_date AS account_open_date, COALESCE(at.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) AS total_income, COALESCE(at.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense, COALESCE(at.max_balance, 0) AS max_balance, COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count, dist.A3 AS region, dist.A10 AS urban_ratio, dist.A11 AS avg_salary, dist.A14 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000 FROM client_accounts AS ca JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = ca.account_district_id LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS at ON at.account_id = ca.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON lc.account_id = ca.account_id LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = ca.account_id ORDER BY ca.account_open_date

LEFT JOIN loan_counts ON lc.account_id = ca.account_id
LEFT JOIN card_counts ON cc.account_id = ca.account_id
